correctness.rationale: PASS: The Walsh degree-four endpoint projection norm is exactly E|K_{4,n}| by finite group convolution. The coordinate recursion K_{4,n+1}=K_{4,n}+epsilon K_{3,n} gives nonnegative increment E(|K3|-|K4|)_+ and, by sign-change identity, a weighted sum over adjacent parity nodes of the quartic P_N(s). Its explicit four simple roots are separated by more than the node step two, so exactly the claimed pair of positive-root intervals contribute, with exact binomial factors. Zero increment iff all four roots lie on the parity lattice. Integrality of both squared roots forces D_N^2=6(2N-3)^2+10; the two Pell seed orbits under multiplying by 5+2sqrt(6) grow geometrically, proving O(log X) possible plateaus. The n=7 plateau and finite range cutoff are separate: only n<=10^100 is computationally excluded, not all n. Independent new exact-integer derivation checked polynomial, increment and plateau arithmetic on N=5..60.
